name: Gladly

field_reviews.reason: developer.gladly.com/rest/ (fetched live): 'Gladly API uses token-based Basic Authentication', credentials are agent email as username and API token as password in the Authorization header, HTTPS required.

The only documented scheme is an API token carried over HTTP Basic; tokens are created in-app by users with the API User permission and 'can be used to perform any API request without restriction'. The api_key/basic_auth pairing correctly describes credential type plus transport. (Public Answers API is the one unauthenticated exception, public content only.)

Correct for the core platform: gladly.com/pricing has only 'Get a demo' CTAs, no published pricing, no trial; third-party comparisons confirm demo-led sales (~$180/seat, 10-seat minimum). However, in 2026 Gladly launched a self-serve Shopify app (apps.shopify.com/gladly) with a 30-day free trial, no credit card, so 'no self-serve signup or public free trial' is no longer strictly true for that SMB product. Whether the Shopify tier grants REST API token access is undocumented, so contact_sales remains the right class for API access.

REST reference covers customers, conversations, agents, tasks and task comments, freeform topics, exports, public answers, lookup adaptor and webhook management, with a large webhook event catalog (agent status, contacts, conversations, customer profiles, exports, tasks...).
REST over HTTPS at https://{organization}.gladly.com with JSON payloads; no GraphQL, gRPC or vendor MCP surface documented on developer.gladly.com.

Re-searched independently: no MCP server anywhere on developer.gladly.com or gladly.com. docs.composio.dev/toolkits/gladly returns 404 (re-confirmed today). StackOne's hosted Gladly MCP server (stackone.com/connectors/gladly/mcp/, 65 actions, 'Built by StackOne') exists and is clearly partner/aggregator-hosted, not vendor-official, matching the draft's classification.

Once an org exists, API tokens are self-serve in-app, the REST API is fully documented publicly (no login wall), and webhooks are supported; the constraint is commercial access, not technical capability.
Platform access is demo/sales-led with no published pricing; this is the binding constraint on getting credentials, consistent with access=contact_sales.

notes: Independently fetched developer.gladly.com/rest/ (draft evidence URL, live and matching on Basic auth, API User permission, webhooks), confirmed the Composio toolkit 404, the StackOne partner MCP (65 actions), and the demo-only core platform. One update the draft predates or omits: Gladly's Shopify App Store listing now offers a self-serve 30-day free trial for an SMB-oriented AI product, so the access story has a narrow self-serve side door, though REST API access through it is unverified; hence access is PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED rather than contradicted.
